title: Dungeon Code Settings
description: Configure global settings for Dungeon Code gamification modules.

ProjectKey.title: Player Card Project Key
ProjectKey.description: Key of the project where player cards are stored

DamageDiceCount.title: Damage Dice Count
DamageDiceCount.description: How many dice to roll for damage

DamageDiceSides.title: Damage Dice Sides
DamageDiceSides.description: Number of sides on the damage dice (e.g., 4 = d4)

XpLevelMultiplier.title: XP Level Multiplier
XpLevelMultiplier.description: XP required per level = current level × multiplier

XpRewardCritical.title: XP for Critical
XpRewardCritical.description: XP awarded for completing a Critical priority task

XpRewardMajor.title: XP for Major
XpRewardMajor.description: XP awarded for completing a Major priority task

XpRewardNormal.title: XP for Normal
XpRewardNormal.description: XP awarded for completing a Normal priority task

XpRewardMinor.title: XP for Minor
XpRewardMinor.description: XP awarded for completing a Minor priority task

HpBonusDiceCount.title: HP Bonus Dice Count
HpBonusDiceCount.description: Number of dice to roll on level up

HpBonusDiceSides.title: HP Bonus Dice Sides
HpBonusDiceSides.description: Number of sides per die (e.g., 8 = d8)
